Every candidate was opened directly and confirmed to be a real paginated BrowseGrid PLP whose JSON browseResultCount field matches its own rendered '<N> Items' header exactly (verified for all 10 rows below). The 'Shop All New Arrivals' figure (1260) does not equal the sum of the department cuts (which total far higher), so these are independent curated selections under one New Arrivals umbrella, not a strict parent/children partition - kept as sibling rows, each with its own exact verified count, per the brief's 'genuinely different listings -> keep both' rule. Collection-page test applied to 'Modern New Arrivals' (https://www.perigold.com/events/modern-new-arrivals~e250702.html, canonicalizes to /curated/modern-new-arrivals~ev396405.html): opened it directly and confirmed it is a real BrowseGrid product listing (browseResultCount:30, matches visible '30 Items' header) of actual purchasable products, not an editorial/lookbook/campaign page with no product grid - so it passes as a genuine (style-themed) New Arrivals PLP rather than being excluded as a marketing landing page. Checked sitemap (seo-category-sitemap~0.xml) - no New Arrivals-named category nodes exist there (expected, this is a merchandising concept, not category taxonomy), confirming the nav-discovered set above is complete. No individual PDP 'New' badges were treated as PLPs.
